title: Present simple / continuous
recall: Present simple va continuous qachon ishlatiladi? Har biriga 2 ta qoida va state verb'larga 3 ta misol ayt.
formula: Simple: odat, doimiy holat, fakt, jadval — I work / She works / Do you work?
Continuous: hozir yoki shu kunlarda, vaqtinchalik, o'zgarish — I am working / Are you working?
State verbs continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: know, understand, believe, belong, need, want, mean, like

pairs.b: I'm living with my parents this month.
The chef is smelling the soup.

items.uz: Men hozir qahva ichmayapman, choy ichyapman.
en: I'm not drinking coffee now, I'm drinking tea.
I'm not drinking coffee, I'm drinking tea.
I'm not drinking coffee right now, I'm drinking tea.
What do you do for a living?
Malika is staying with her mother this week.
Malika is staying at her mother's this week.
Malika is living with her mother this week.
The chef is smelling the soup.
The cook is smelling the soup.
Jasur is always losing his keys!
Prices are going up every month.

items.uz: Men shu kunlarda bu kitobni o'qiyapman.
en: I'm reading this book at the moment.
I'm reading this book these days.
These days I'm reading this book.
My brother usually doesn't work on Saturdays.
My brother doesn't usually work on Saturdays.
My brother usually doesn't work on Saturday.
Why are you looking at me like that?
This shirt looks good on you.
This dress looks good on you.
You are being really careless today.

speak: Har kuni nima qilishing haqida 5 ta gap ayt (present simple).
Shu hafta hayotingda nima o'zgaryapti — 5 ta gap (present continuous).
Ikkalasini aralashtir: odatda nima qilasan va shu kunlarda nima boshqacha?
